scope: Controlled capture logic only; no browser or packed-consumer claim.

checks: fill and select resolve once and recheck the retained target before mutation
replaced or moved retained target cannot redirect mutation to a new selector match
loss of document or attachment during final readiness prevents mutation
expired allowance prevents mutation even after successful target resolution
keyboard capture preserves non-strict choice and cannot focus a replacement
result.scope: Controlled resident target ownership; native/browser checks are separate
